_comment: The route classification -- the one table both the Python middleware and
the Go front door are held to. Read by tests/test_isolation.py (the
in-process sweep over the FastAPI route table), by tests/contract/ (the
suite that drives a live server over TCP), and, from Phase 2 of the Go
migration, by the Go module's own sweep. Edit it here and nowhere else;
docs/go-migration/PLAN.md section 8 is the argument for one table.
public      reachable with no session. Must equal api/auth.py:PUBLIC_PATHS.
shared      needs a session, then shows every caller the same thing; the
value is the reason it is shared and has to read as one.
user_scoped needs a session and belongs to one person: another account is
answered 404, never 403 (ADR 5, ADR 22); the value says why.
admin       needs a session belonging to an admin; answered 403 to anybody
else, before routing, by living under admin_prefix (ADR 17).
placeholders  what a templated segment is filled with when a sweep needs
a concrete URL. The values need not resolve: every sweep
asserts on a refusal that happens before any handler runs.

shared./api/decks: every caller may list; the list is filtered to what they may see, and carries an owner per deck (ADR 22)
shared./api/decks/import: writes into the caller's OWN library, never into an owner named in the path
shared./api/sim/mana: submits a job against a deck the caller may see; the owner is resolved through Library and the job is scoped
shared./api/sim/lands: submits a job too, same resolution, and the job is scoped
shared./api/sim/shelf: computes the closed form for a deck the caller may see; resolved through Library, answered in the request
shared./api/sim/policy: submits a job against a deck the caller may see; same resolution as /api/sim/mana, and the job is scoped
shared./api/forge: whether the Forge is installed on this instance
shared./api/sim/forge: submits a job against two decks the caller may see; both resolved through Library, and the job is scoped
shared./api/cards/identify: the same pool, asked the other way round -- a set code and a collector number in, a card name out; it reads no deck and writes nothing, and the photograph it came from never leaves the browser
shared./api/colors: a fixed taxonomy, no data at all
shared./api/colors/{key}: a fixed taxonomy plus public pool cards
shared./api/glossary: fixed reference prose, no data at all
shared./api/themes: the fixed labelling vocabulary, no data at all
shared./api/lore: fixed reference prose plus public pool cards
shared./api/claude: whether the surface is configured on this instance
shared./api/claude/personas: a fixed roster of voices, no data at all
shared./api/tarot/reading: a seeded shuffle of a public-domain deck; no state
shared./api/claude/theme: submits a job; the conversation is the client's and nothing is stored, and the job is scoped
shared./api/claude/theme/proposal: submits a job; colours and commanders out of the shared pool, and the job is scoped
shared./api/claude/research: submits a job; the question is the caller's and no deck is reachable, and the job is scoped
shared./api/claude/scan: submits a job; the capture is the caller's, no deck is reachable, and the job is scoped
shared./api/art/motion/{oracle_id}/{effect}: a shared cache over public card art; nothing per-account
shared./api/art/motion/{oracle_id}/{effect}/{fi: one file of the same shared cache
shared./api/symbols/{code}.svg: a shared cache of public mana-symbol art; nothing per-account
shared./api/ocr/{name}: a shared cache of the Apache-2.0 OCR engine and its notice; the same files for everyone, nothing per-account

user_scoped./api/jobs: the caller's own jobs and nobody else's; a leaked list is a list of what somebody is working on (ADR 5)
user_scoped./api/jobs/{job_id}: one job, by id; another account's is a 404, because a 403 would confirm the id names something real (ADR 5)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}: a deck the caller may see; another account's private deck is a 404, and a write to a shared deck they do not own is a 403 (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/validate: reads the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/stats: reads the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/log: the deck's history is as reachable as the deck and no more -- resolved through Library by the same code path (ADR 28)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/artifacts: the deliverables reach as far as the deck does; a primer for a private deck names its whole 99, and the build is a deck write
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/artifacts/{nam: one deliverable; reaches exactly as far as the deck does
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/swap: a deck write; 404 for a private deck the caller cannot see, 403 for a shared one they do not own (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/cards: a deck write; same reach as the deck (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/cards/{name}: a deck write; same reach as the deck (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/entomb: a deck write -- the graveyard is part of the deck file, so its reach is the deck's (ADR 27)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/graveyard/{nam: a deck write; the graveyard's reach is the deck's (ADR 27)
a deck write; the graveyard's reach is the deck's (ADR 27)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/notes/{key}: a deck write; same reach as the deck (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/shared: the sharing flag is the owner's to set; same reach as the deck (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/suggestions: reads the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/wheel: the wheel reads the deck's identity and its 99 to pick a card; spinning a stranger's private wheel would confirm the deck exists
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/commander: reads the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/printings: reads the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does (ADR 22)
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/interview: a conversation about one of the deck's cards; reaches exactly as far as the deck does
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/argue: the case against one of the deck's slots; reaches exactly as far as the deck does
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/argue/deck: the same case swept across a selection; reaches exactly as far as the deck does
user_scoped./api/decks/{owner}/{slug}/dossier: the commander dossier, read through the deck; reaches exactly as far as the deck does

admin./api/admin/users: every account on the instance, addresses included
admin./api/admin/users/{username}: grants admin, disables and re-enables, and deletes an account outright
admin./api/admin/stats/system: the process, memory and volume of the box
admin./api/admin/stats/storage: what every store on the volume weighs
admin./api/admin/stats/claude: where the instance's Claude tokens went
admin./api/admin/stats/activity: accounts, sessions and edits across time
admin./api/admin/stats/traffic: requests per day by route template
admin./api/admin/stats/fly: the platform's own view of this instance
